text:
```yaml
name: Lychee

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check-links:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Lychee
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fail: true
          failIfEmpty: false
          format: "github"
          jobSummary: true
          workingDirectory: "."
          args: "-v"
```
